title.purpose: Major section headings and definitive totals.

body.purpose: Source values, confirmed values, explanations, and recovery copy.

label.purpose: Buttons, field labels, progress, and concise metadata.

shadows.name: footer-lift
shadows.purpose: CSS preview equivalent of the native totals footer's 8dp shadow elevation.

motion.name: content-size-standard

components.name: Finish Review Button
components.description: The single primary completion action; prototype boundary copy remains visible beside it.
components.css: .ds-finish-review { min-height: 56px; padding: 16px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #075D35; color: #FFFFFF; font: 500 14px/1.43 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-finish-review:hover { background: #00391F; } .ds-finish-review:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C6F0D5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-finish-review:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Line Navigation
components.description: Simple previous/current/next context for one invoice line.
components.css: .ds-line-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 64px; padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #C0C9C1; color: #171D19; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-line-nav div { display: grid; gap: 2px; text-align: center; } .ds-line-nav small { color: #414943; } .ds-line-nav button { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #075D35; font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-line-nav button:hover { background: #E8F5EB; } .ds-line-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C6F0D5; }

components.name: OCR Source Value
components.description: Read-only evidence stays visually neutral and byte-preserved.
components.css: .ds-source-value { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-height: 64px; padding: 14px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #C0C9C1; background: #FFFFFF; color: #171D19; font: 400 14px/1.43 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-source-value strong { font-weight: 500; } .ds-source-value span { color: #414943; }

components.name: Confirmed Value Field
components.description: Editable confirmed value paired with, but never overwriting, OCR evidence.
components.css: .ds-confirmed-field { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 5px; min-height: 64px; padding: 10px 14px; background: #E8F5EB; color: #171D19; font: 400 14px/1.43 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-confirmed-field span { font-size: 12px; color: #414943; } .ds-confirmed-field input { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 42px 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #707972; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #171D19; font: inherit; } .ds-confirmed-field b { position: absolute; right: 24px; bottom: 21px; color: #075D35; font-size: 12px; } .ds-confirmed-field input:hover { border-color: #075D35; } .ds-confirmed-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C6F0D5; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #075D35; }

components.name: Expiry Row
components.description: One expiry owns its quantity, date, and one explicit row action.
components.css: .ds-expiry-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr 1.35fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: #F0F3EF; color: #171D19; font: 400 14px/1.43 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-expiry-row label { display: grid; gap: 4px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-expiry-row input, .ds-expiry-row button { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #707972; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #171D19; font: inherit; } .ds-expiry-row .ds-split { border-color: transparent; background: transparent; color: #075D35; font-weight: 500; } .ds-expiry-row button:hover { border-color: #075D35; } .ds-expiry-row input:focus-visible, .ds-expiry-row button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C6F0D5; outline-offset: 1px; } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-expiry-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .ds-expiry-row strong, .ds-expiry-row .ds-split { grid-column: 1 / -1; } }

components.name: Add Expiry Button
components.description: A labeled full-width secondary action beneath all expiry rows.
components.css: .ds-add-expiry { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #707972; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #075D35; font: 500 14px/1.43 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-add-expiry:hover { background: #E8F5EB; } .ds-add-expiry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C6F0D5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-add-expiry:active { background: #C6F0D5; }

components.name: Expandable Totals Footer
components.description: Anchored truthful total, finish action, expansion control, and prototype disclosure.
components.html:
Invoice net totalEGP 171.00

components.css: .ds-totals-footer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #171D19; box-shadow: 0 -4px 18px rgba(23,29,25,.16); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-totals-footer div { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-totals-footer small { color: #414943; } .ds-totals-footer strong { font-size: 22px; } .ds-footer-action { min-height: 56px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #075D35; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; } .ds-expand { min-width: 48px; min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: #075D35; } .ds-totals-footer button:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-totals-footer button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C6F0D5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-totals-footer p { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0; text-align: center; color: #414943; font-size: 11px; } @media (max-width: 400px) { .ds-totals-footer { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; } .ds-footer-action { grid-column: 1 / -1; } }

narrative.overview:
Pharma Auto should feel like a clear, well-lit pharmacy counter where one consequential task is handled at a time. The interface uses familiar Material 3 behavior, restrained color, explicit labels, and progressive disclosure so a nontechnical operator can compare evidence, correct a value, and recover from an error without learning system terminology.

Evidence and confirmed data stay visually distinct, while consequential states remain truthful. The current Android surface is a non-persistent prototype check: its design must never imply that data was saved, sent, or committed to Genius when that action has not occurred.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, linear review instead of dense all-lines editing.
OCR evidence remains visible and unchanged beside confirmed values.
Forest green carries primary action and progress; amber is reserved for uncertain evidence.
English and Arabic receive equal hierarchy, readable wrapping, and native RTL/LTR behavior.
Large controls and plain-language recovery support one-handed counter work.

rules.name: The One Amber Meaning Rule
rules.body: Amber communicates uncertain source evidence and must not become a decorative accent.

rules.name: The Plain Language Rule
rules.body: Labels name the operator's task or data directly; implementation terms and policy prose stay out of the working screen.

rules.name: The One Linear Task Rule
rules.body: Progressive disclosure may shorten a screen, but it must not hide which invoice line or expiry row an edit belongs to.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: Elevation marks persistent action hierarchy, not decoration; ordinary evidence and expiry groups use tonal layering instead of shadows.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: A control may say save or show a definitive total only when the product has actually performed that operation or completed that calculation.

dos: Do preserve raw OCR evidence while showing confirmed values separately.
Do use explicit labels, row ownership, 48dp targets, and specific recovery messages.
Do keep financial totals unavailable until every required value is valid.
Do mirror layouts for Arabic while isolating mixed-direction display text only in the UI.
Do reserve the anchored footer for totals and the single completion action.
donts: Don't imply persistence, Connector submission, or a Genius commit before it occurs.
Don't use amber, red, shadows, cards, or pills as decoration.
Don't hide expiry quantity ownership or place multiple unlabeled icon-only actions on a row.
Don't reprice old stock or surface policy prose as if it were an editable screen control.
Don't replace the linear review flow with a dense spreadsheet-style editor.
